name: What steps are involved in the residential remodeling process from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the residential remodeling process from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our remodeling process begins with an on-site consultation to review your goals, measure the space, and identify structural or trade requirements. Next, we provide a detailed project scope and proposal. Once approved and materials are scheduled, our team handles demolition, custom framing, drywall installation, and coordinates sub-trades for mechanical rough-ins. We then complete the fine interior finishes—including tile or marble installation, doors, trim carpentry, and interior painting—followed by a comprehensive walkthrough to confirm every detail matches your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process moves from initial consultation and scoping to demolition, framing, trade rough-ins, drywall, tile, finish carpentry, interior painting, and a final walkthrough.
